# Provenance of `envelope-vectors.json`

These vectors are not generated by this tree. They are copied byte for byte
from the Go reference implementation contributed in the open pull request
[#169](https://github.com/GenAI-Security-Project/agent-control-standard/pull/169)
by @President (fork `disciplinedware/agent-control-standard`, branch
`refimpl/go-port`), at `reference-implementations/agt-go/internal/envelope/testdata/vectors.json`.

They pin the interoperability contract ACS v0.1.0 leaves implicit: the HKDF
inputs (SHA-256, no salt, `info = session_id`, 32 bytes), the JCS form of the
signed input, and the HMAC-SHA256 signature over it. `tests/test_crypto_vectors.py`
asserts this implementation agrees with them.

When #169 merges, that file becomes the in-tree source and this copy should be
deleted and the test pointed at `../agt-go/internal/envelope/testdata/vectors.json`.
